name: heroui-pro-themes
description: HeroUI Pro themes for design-promax. Live in THIS skill: THEMES.json + themes.css. Agents MUST ask which theme before building UI.

skill_pack.note: Primary path for this skill (HeroUI v2 + TW3 + sources/). Copy themes.css into the project and set data-theme. Do not tell the user themes are missing when these files exist.

gate.when: Any design-promax / HeroUI Pro UI task, unless user already named a theme in the same message
gate.prompt: Which HeroUI Pro theme should we use?
gate.do_not: Do not pick a theme silently. Do not start composing UI until the user answers (or already named one).

apply.step_1: Ask theme (or use the one user named)
apply.step_2: Copy skill themes.css into the project (or import from skill path)
apply.step_4: Wire a theme switcher with options Default|Brutalism|Glass|Mouve
apply.step_5: Brutalism: load Anton + Share Tech Mono as --font-brutal-display / --font-brutal-body

optional_npm_upgrade.when: User has HeroUI Pro license + wants official package CSS
optional_npm_upgrade.note: Optional. Skill pack themes.css is enough for design-promax projects.

default.label: Default
default.feel: Standard HeroUI radii, shadows, and typography. Clean product baseline.
compose_notes: Use clean_product button matrix (pill CTAs) unless user says otherwise

typography.scale: text-tiny 12 / text-small 14 / text-medium 16 / text-large 18 / h1 text-3xl sm:text-4xl
typography.numbers: tabular-nums on any column of numbers

brutalism.label: Brutalism
brutalism.feel: Bold high-contrast: sharp edges, thick borders, expressive shadows. Fonts: Anton + Share Tech Mono. Zero radius, minimal soft shadows.
compose_notes: Prefer radius-none / sharp corners over radius-full pills
Thick borders, high contrast type, mono accents OK
Do not soft-glass or mauve this look

typography.scale: h1 text-5xl sm:text-7xl leading-none; body text-small

glass.label: Glass
glass.feel: Glassmorphism: backdrop blur, semi-transparent surfaces, soft overlay shadows. Default typography kept.
compose_notes: Need visible backdrop (image, gradient, or --background-gradient) behind blurred cards
Cards/modals/popovers should feel translucent, not solid chalk

spacing.page: px-4 py-8 sm:px-6 sm:py-12 over a visible backdrop

mouve.label: Mouve
mouve.feel: Refined mauve/warm-purple. Raised accent fills with specular highlight; tactile pressed shadows on neutral pills. Default typography.
compose_notes: Saturated accent on filled CTAs, steppers, switches, progress
Neutral pills get inset pressed shadow on press

design_contract.rule: After the theme gate, write DESIGN.md into the project root from the template, filled from themes[id] + the chosen style preset. On later sessions, if DESIGN.md exists in the project, read it and skip the gate.

activation: Set data-theme on <html>. Import alone is not enough.

showcase_packs.description: Homepage / marketing showcase blocks on heroui.pro - use as quality targets and route hints. Theme still applies across all packs.

axis_model.pro_theme: Default | Brutalism | Glass | Mouve - from skill THEMES.json + themes.css (ask first)
axis_model.style_preset: clean_product | trust_green | chat_soft | … - compose recipe from STYLE_PRESETS.json
axis_model.rule: Theme × style × route. Theme is asked; apply skill themes.css; style defaults to clean_product; route from intent.
